title: Tabbi themes (themes.v1)
description: Sources/TabbiKitCore/Themes/themes.json: every theme of the open panel in picker order, the default theme, kit theme values from before themes existed, and the light drawn on glass surfaces. The closed notch is pure black in every theme. What the enum values do (accent treatments, gentle motion, glass) is code, pinned by shared/fixtures/themes/themes.json.

defaultTheme.description: The theme used when neither settings nor a kit picks one.

legacyKitThemes.description: Old values of a kit's theme field, to the theme they mean.

glassSheen.description: The drawn light of a glass card: a fill brighter at the top, a glint near the top-leading corner that fades toward the middle, and a rim lit from above.

themes.description: In picker order. Ids are unique.

color.description: An sRGB color with 0...1 components: white for a gray, or red, green and blue. Opacity defaults to 1.

family.description: The picker group every build reads: calm hardware-black looks, or warm soft looks made for studying. Stays one of these two so builds from before group still decode the file.

group.description: The picker group in builds that know it, in place of family: sweet for the milk, candy and soda themes. Optional; a value a build does not know falls back to family.

accents.description: What the theme does to each module's accent: keeps it, grays it, saturates it (lifted to 4.5:1 on black) or mixes it toward warm cream. With a palette accent it still colors what tells modules apart, and builds from before palette accents use it for everything.

typeface.description: SF Pro Rounded or SF Pro.

motion.description: gentle plays every spring 30% longer with 0.08 less bounce.

controls.description: What icon buttons and the tab bar selection sit on: the palette's surface, or Liquid Glass where the system has it.

surfaces.description: What cards are drawn as: the palette's surface, or frosted glass under the glass sheen.

glow.description: A soft color rising from the panel's bottom edge. Absent for a flat body.

accent.description: The theme's own key color: the active module's ring, selected tab, primary button and chips wear it in place of the module's accent. Absent to keep each module's accent. Opaque, 4.5:1 on every card.

onAccent.description: Text and symbols on an accent fill. Absent for the background (black), which is what builds from before palette accents draw.
